summary: GRAVEYARD underwriting pass covered the same provisional 12-company batch in parallel. Fresh primary filings materially advance ALAB, NBIS, PL, IONQ and NVDA; GEV already has a publishable canonical record. The other six active names remain identity-valid but underwriting-incomplete. No score/rank inference is made. Most important new risk flags are NBIS's $5.0B convertible financing and IONQ's $1.8B SkyWater acquisition with approximately $1.056B cash usage and incomplete purchase accounting.

materialFindings.finding: IONQ completed SkyWater on July 31, 2026 for approximately $1.8B consideration including 24.1m shares and $741.3m cash; total cash use including debt repayment/transaction costs was about $1.056B, while first-half operating loss was $608.8m. Acquisition accounting remained incomplete in the Q2 filing.

NBIS filed Q2 results on August 12 and subsequently launched/priced an upsized $5.0B convertible senior-note offering on August 19-20; dilution, interest burden, conversion mechanics and post-offering liquidity must be normalized before scoring.
Planet Labs filed a fresh September 3 Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, providing current financial footing for a deeper backlog/customer/cash analysis.
ALAB and NVDA have fresh 2026 Q2/Q3 primary filings suitable for financial, concentration, margin and balance-sheet extraction; this pass does not fabricate unextracted values.
